title: Update, format version 1
description: One development in a story, in our own words. Our pipeline writes one from each piece of news in the bots' results; a story's updates, in order, are its timeline.

format.description: Says this record is an update, in format version 1.

story_id.description: The story whose timeline this update belongs to.

headline.description: What happened, in one line of our own words.

body.description: More detail, in our own words. Left out when the headline says it all.

reported_at.description: When this news was first reported, as near as our pipeline can tell (the earliest source's time). The timeline runs in this order.

sources.description: The public posts and pages this update is based on, as links. Left out when the bots' result gives none.

corrects.description: An earlier update in the same story that this one corrects. Readers see that earlier update marked as corrected.

state.description: live: it shows in the timeline. withdrawn: our AI found it wasn't true, and it no longer shows.

withdrawn_reason.description: Why the update was withdrawn, in our own words. Only when the state is withdrawn.

created_at.description: When our pipeline wrote the update.
